page_topic_one_liner: Redirect chains — multi-hop 301/302 sequences, SEO authority loss, detection with crawlers, and direct-redirect fixes
differentiator_vs_generic: This is technical SEO redirect chain diagnosis, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a horizontal URL hop flow diagram (A → 301 → B → 301 → C) with status badges, NOT an AI assistant or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Horizontal redirect chain flow — URL A box → 301 arrow → URL B box → 301 arrow → URL C box, klein-blue accent on broken/long chain warning badge at 3rd hop
Secondary: crawler audit report tear-out showing "Redirect Chains" filter row with hop count blur
Tertiary: fixed direct redirect comparison (A → single 301 → C dashed shortcut overlay)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is redirect chain SEO not GEO)
Generic arrow icon alone without multi-hop chain
Server rack or DevOps dashboard unrelated to redirect flow
